title: Simulated annealing on scaled peaks
description: Runs an accepted/rejected Markov chain on the original 49×49 peaks energy and compares best visited energy with exhaustive search.

reproduction.method: Symmetric rounded-Gaussian grid Metropolis proposals and geometric cooling
reproduction.description: Runs an accepted/rejected Markov chain on the original 49×49 peaks energy and compares best visited energy with exhaustive search.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
1,600 proposals rather than 1,000, integer grid states with zero-based row/column coordinates instead of continuous states rounded on evaluation.
Retains scale 1/10, proposal standard deviation 2 and cooling factor 0.995; out-of-grid proposals reject.
Scatter energy map and accepted-state path replace 3D surfaces/histograms. Tracks best state separately and reports stability without claiming guaranteed global convergence.

metrics.convergence_diagnostic: Last 100 energies stable; not a proof of global convergence

checks.name: Every acceptance decision obeys the Metropolis rule
Recorded chain energies equal the actual objective
Best-so-far energy is monotone and bounded by exhaustive search
checks.detail: Measured 0.000000; gap ≥ −1e-12 and best history nonincreasing

checks.name: The run includes accepted uphill moves and rejected proposals
Cooling ends at the prescribed positive temperature
